[Section] Analysis
[source_id=49] In this section, we first analyze the performance of Inception and Joint. We also analyze the performance of different models on different quality classes. The high-level representations learned by different models are also visualized and discussed. As the Wikipedia test set is larger and more balanced than that of arXiv, our analysis will focus on Wikipedia.
